functional_goal: Add a deterministic bounded mathematical research-state layer that derives the current dependency/obstruction picture from existing append-only workflow records and gives the web model one transparent advisory next action without changing workflow authority or verified .tex publication semantics.

seven_deliveries.goal: Approve scope, record the synchronized baseline, freeze complexity budgets and protocol-3 research contract fixtures, and make the constraints machine-checkable.

seven_deliveries.name: pure_types_and_graph_algorithms
seven_deliveries.goal: Implement pure deterministic research types, dependency graph construction, cycle detection, reachability, frontier and digest with exhaustive unit/property tests.

seven_deliveries.name: normalized_append_only_research_records
seven_deliveries.goal: Normalize existing plans, screenings, branches, failures, replans, retrieval and verifier findings into existing logical channels and run projection in read-only shadow.

seven_deliveries.name: protocol_three_research_contracts
seven_deliveries.goal: Enable structured protocol-3 research fields for new runs while protocol-1/2 behavior and the generic rethlas_step envelope remain compatible.

seven_deliveries.name: bounded_advisory_context
seven_deliveries.goal: Expose a bounded obstruction-centered quotient and one deterministic advisory action without giving advice any authority.

seven_deliveries.name: paired_web_driven_mathematical_evaluation
seven_deliveries.goal: Compare protocol 2 and 3 on a frozen real-use corpus with normal web research, workspace Bash/CAS and independent evaluation of final verified .tex outputs.

seven_deliveries.name: cutover_release_and_final_receipt
seven_deliveries.goal: Make protocol 3 the default only after all engineering and mathematical gates pass, prove rollback on copied state, qualify the release and complete the final receipt.

recording_rules.runtime_records: Server-normalized append-only records contain concise mathematical conclusions, typed methods/obstructions/evidence and server-issued identity/order facts; they never contain raw web conversation transcripts or private reasoning traces.
recording_rules.engineering_receipts: Every delivery records before/after commit, changed files, graph changes, commands, exit codes, evidence hashes, failures, repairs, rollback and pending checks before it is accepted.
recording_rules.failure_policy: Failed attempts and rejected evidence are retained and classified rather than erased.
recording_rules.final_delivery: The only final mathematical artifact remains proof_verified.tex through the existing LaTeX, verifier, permit and finalizer path.

A3.required: Retry/crash/concurrency, identity, capability, branch/verifier firewall and finalizer non-regression.

A4.required: Real web-driven paired mathematical evaluation with normal research/workspace tools and verified .tex outputs.
A4.evidence: All eight frozen AB/BA pairs and sixteen treatments completed under the same GPT-5.6 Sol model surface and connector profile. Protocol 2 and protocol 3 each produced verified proof_verified.tex for 8/8 cases, each achieved 7/8 first-verification passes, each had one order-balanced LaTeX repair, all verifier finding counts were zero, protocol 3 had zero harmful-advice events, and the externally sourced Zsigmondy case passed focused retrieval plus stored-source reference audit in both protocols. A5.required: Task-envelope, projection latency, RSS, writes, replay and shutdown non-regression.
